rows.question: Does the Student-t model fail the Christoffersen independence test over the full history? Give the p-value.
rows.answer:
Yes, the Student-t model fails the Christoffersen independence test over the full history (from 2020-10-05 to 2026-10-30 at a 99% confidence level).

- **Christoffersen independence p-value:** 0.0039753314754506315 (or 0.0040)
- **Christoffersen conditional-coverage p-value:** 0.013852611034221942 (reject = true)
- **Exceptions:** 13 (expected 14.93)
- **Kupiec p-value:** 0.6077159247477892 (pass)
